New I, Emperor collection lands on the Sabaton store!

  • August 6, 2026

Greetings, metalheads!

Command attention wherever you go with our brand-new I, Emperor collection!

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

This latest addition to the Sabaton store includes a unisex t-shirt, ladies’ t-shirt, kids’ t-shirt, and a unisex zip hoodie, each paying tribute to the legendary Napoleon Bonaparte. Featuring a striking coat of arms design worthy of an emperor, this collection is made for those who refuse to blend into the crowd.

Choose your favourite, wear it with pride, stand tall and let the world know who’s in charge. Get yours now!
